worlds.name: Sunny Meadows
worlds.blurb: Warm sunshine, friendly cones, and a first taste of the open road.

worlds.name: Candy Coast
worlds.blurb: Bubblegum beaches, jelly slicks, and beach balls with a mind of their own.

worlds.name: Citrus Canyon
worlds.blurb: Zesty canyon gusts, tumbling weeds, and sun-baked switchbacks.

worlds.name: Bubblegum City
worlds.blurb: Neon lights, busy lanes, and taxis that apparently have somewhere to be.

worlds.name: Rainbow Ridge
worlds.blurb: Pastel peaks and strong breezes. Hold the wheel and enjoy the view.

worlds.name: Tropic Tides
worlds.blurb: Turquoise water, rolling waves, and a boardwalk made of seashells.

worlds.name: Starfruit Space
worlds.blurb: Moon-dust drifting, friendly planets, and a whole lot of stars.

worlds.name: Frosty Peaks
worlds.blurb: Mittens on, everyone. Snowballs bounce and the road has other plans.

worlds.name: Marshmallow Volcano
worlds.blurb: A warm, gooey volcano that somehow smells like toasted marshmallows.

worlds.name: Aurora Finale
worlds.blurb: Under the dancing lights, every trick you have learned comes together.
